entries.title: An answer on a card reads as words in its task
entries.body: When Firstmate answers a question on a card, the task's Activity now opens to the answer in plain words, a line for each paragraph and list item, instead of the code behind the card. The Cards row still opens the card itself.

picture.alt: A question's task with the line that closed it opened, showing the answer's paragraphs and numbered steps as plain words
